name: workspace
//packageManager: Pinned so corepack in CI/Docker uses the pnpm that wrote pnpm-lock.yaml. Unpinned, containers pulled pnpm 11 against a v10 lockfile and install failed.

scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./frontend" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck

//pnpm: Overrides pull transitive build-tool dependencies past their advisories. None of these reach the shipped bundle — orval and typedoc generate the API client, esbuild builds the artifact server — but a build tool that can be made to read arbitrary files or exhaust memory still runs on a developer's machine and in CI.
